examples.explanation: Choose k = 3, reverse the first 3 characters. Reverse "dca" to "acd", resulting string s = "acdb", which is the lexicographically smallest string achievable.
Choose k = 3, reverse the last 3 characters. Reverse "bba" to "abb", so the resulting string is "aabb", which is the lexicographically smallest string achievable.
Choose k = 2, reverse the first 2 characters. Reverse "zx" to "xz", so the resulting string is "xzy", which is the lexicographically smallest string achievable.
